en.heading: Choose a mate for %{name}
en.info: If an ant has mates, then they will be loyal and only have antlings with their mates (unless affairs are toggled on). Potential mates are listed below! The lines connecting the two ants may give a hint on their compatibility with one another, and any existing romantic feelings will be shown with small hearts.
en.no_kits_pair: m_c has no offspring with r_c.
en.no_kit_warning: This pair can't have biological antlings.
